origin.description: Inverse logit of a numeric object.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric object. Missing values are allowed.

origin.details: The installed function is plogis. The inverse logit is exp(x)/(1+exp(x)), computed as 1/(1+exp(-x)). -Inf and Inf return 0 and 1. Missing values stay missing.
origin.value: The inverse logits of the input values, with the same shape.

translation.description: Inverse logit of a numeric object.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric values. Missing values are NaN.

translation.details: This is 1/(1+exp(-x)), matching plogis. -inf and inf return 0 and 1. A scalar returns a float. An array keeps its shape.
translation.value: The inverse logits of the input values, with the same shape.
translation.example:
from boot.util import inv_logit

print(inv_logit([float("-inf"), -1, 0, 1, float("inf")]))
